headline: Only Rutgers have beaten Indiana
dek: The defeat came in October, and Indiana have won fifteen and drawn four around it. Michal Mroz has kept eight clean sheets behind a defence that has conceded thirteen goals all season.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Goals have tracked the foot of the table more closely than its top: Michigan and Penn State, the only programmes without a conference win, have scored the fewest, while the leaders are not the side that has scored the most.

wire.line: Zach Ramsey has scored nineteen of Washington's forty-five goals this season.

findings.label: observed

next_match.line: Missouri State have already beaten Penn State; Indiana have not lost since October.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
